posts.caption:
$125 back on a smart thermostat in Ontario.

The Home Renovation Savings program pays it on a qualifying smart thermostat if you are an Enbridge Gas customer heating with natural gas, or connected to the Ontario grid and heating or cooling electrically. It covers single and semi-detached homes, row and townhomes, and mobile homes on a permanent foundation, as long as you have not already claimed one through the program.

Costco carries a model that qualifies, and we have put this rebate through ourselves, so we know where the form trips people up.

We tell you upfront whether the thermostat we are installing qualifies, and help you apply. Not sure what you have now? Send a photo of it. Link in bio.

#automation #smarthome #durhamregion #smartthermostat #ontario

posts.caption:
Three texts over twelve days to someone who had work done 18 months ago. In the clip the third one gets "can you come by Friday".

Each text is a few cents. Sending them by hand is the expensive part: an afternoon picking names out of the invoices, and most shops never get to it.

Here the list is built from the jobs you already invoiced, the messages go out in your name, and the run stops the moment someone replies, so nobody gets a fourth text after saying yes.

Free walkthrough in bio if your old invoices are the list you have never worked.

posts.caption:
It's 11pm. Lights on, doors unlocked, heat still up. You're already in bed.

One tag by the bed. Tap a phone on it and the downstairs lights go off, the doors lock, the thermostat sets back for the night and the phone goes to Sleep.

The tag costs about a dollar. The work is in what sits behind it.

A lights-only version of this has been running on our own setup for over a month and has not needed touching.

This is a built scene, not phone footage.

Got a room in mind? Text 365-299-3366 with a photo of it.

#automation #smarthome #durhamregion #nfc #hometech

posts.caption:
Up to three days to answer a new lead. That was normal at one service business, because the people answering leads were the same people out doing the work.

They added a bot that replies the moment a lead comes in, answers the basic questions and books a consult. In the first year it booked 30% of their consultations.

The shape fits any shop where the owner is also the one on the job. Our demo line runs the first part of it. Call 1 365 299 3366, say your AC quit, and after you hang up a text lands with what you asked for and how urgent it sounded. The free walkthrough link is in our bio.

Source: Zapier customer story, Results Grow.

#automation #durhamregion #smallbusinessautomation #speedtolead #tradesbusiness
